definitions.divergence: first non-STOP selected target > threshold metres from all GT reference_path nodes; 3D Euclidean
definitions.branch: nearest original included connectivity node, <=3m; >=2 included unobstructed off-GT neighbors excluding logged incoming_position (nearest graph node), or previous distinct current node when incoming_position is null
definitions.termination_priority: budget > no_candidate > stop; all simultaneous flags remain in trajectories
definitions.proxy_confusion: same new evaluation: zero-based final step +1=15 maps to D, earlier maps to C
definitions.historical_confusion: previous saved D7-b proxy categories vs new true categories; includes rerun/rank-induced behavior differences, not pure proxy error
definitions.bootstrap: 2000 scene-cluster draws seed0; step mean difference uses matched finite episodes; branch conditional proportions and step quantiles use separate model denominators under shared scene resampling; never proportion over all subgroup episodes
